prompt: Create an original 180 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 120 BPM; F major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and atmospheric electronic track featuring synthesizers, synth bass, and electronic drums. It builds from a dreamy, arpeggiated intro to a more rhythmic, yet still reflective, main section.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有氛围感的电子音乐，以合成器、合成贝斯和电子鼓为主。从梦幻般的琶音引子开始，逐渐发展成更具节奏感但仍保持沉思氛围的主体部分。
